article_title: Ambika Mod: Ceiling is getting higher for South Asian actors

tasks.prompt: What is the article mainly about?
options: How Ambika Mod trained to become a doctor before acting
Ambika Mod's career choices, her new Black Doves role and the barriers South Asian actors still face
Why Netflix has stopped making spy thrillers
A ranking of the most successful British comedians
tasks.correct_answer: Ambika Mod's career choices, her new Black Doves role and the barriers South Asian actors still face
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מחברת בין בחירות התפקידים של אמביקה מוד, תפקידה החדש, והחסמים המערכתיים בפני שחקנים מדרום אסיה.

tasks.prompt: What did Ofcom find about minority ethnic representation in senior management?
options: It had reached half of all senior jobs.
It was higher than representation in every other role.
People from minority ethnic groups held only 11% of senior management roles across the industry.
It could not find any data about management.
tasks.correct_answer: People from minority ethnic groups held only 11% of senior management roles across the industry.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: לפי Ofcom, בני קבוצות אתניות מיעוטיות היו רק 11% מבעלי תפקידי הניהול הבכיר בתעשייה.

tasks.prompt: What does Mod mean by saying the “glass ceiling is always getting higher”?
options: Film studios are building taller sets.
Actors are expected to perform more stunts.
Her career goals change every year.
Invisible barriers to advancement remain and can feel harder to overcome as she progresses.
tasks.correct_answer: Invisible barriers to advancement remain and can feel harder to overcome as she progresses.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: תקרת זכוכית היא מחסום בלתי נראה לקידום; מוד אומרת שהמחסום עדיין קיים ואף נראה רחוק יותר ככל שהיא מתקדמת.

tasks.prompt: Which type of role does Mod say she will not engage with?
options: A tokenistic or stereotypical role
A role involving comedy
A character based on a novel
A role requiring stunt work
tasks.explanation_hebrew: מוד אומרת שלא תבחר בתפקיד אם הוא נראה לה סמלי בלבד או מבוסס על סטריאוטיפ.

tasks.prompt: What attracted Mod to playing Laila in Black Doves?
options: The character never enters an action scene.
The role subverts spy-story tropes and includes extreme stunt sequences.
The series is filmed at Durham University.
The character is an aspiring novelist.
tasks.correct_answer: The role subverts spy-story tropes and includes extreme stunt sequences.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: התפקיד משך אותה משום שהוא הופך מוסכמות של ז'אנר הריגול ונתן לה לבצע קטעי פעלולים קיצוניים.

tasks.prompt: What does “central tenet” mean when Mod describes her work?
options: A short-term publicity plan
A rule imposed by a streaming service
A core principle that guides her choices
A type of comedy performance
tasks.correct_answer: A core principle that guides her choices
tasks.explanation_hebrew: Central tenet הוא עיקרון מרכזי; במקרה שלה, הרצון לשנות את אופן הצגתן של נשים מדרום אסיה על המסך.

tasks.prompt: Give four examples showing the range of Mod's career and role choices.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין ארבע דוגמאות שונות מן הכתבה לתפקידים, סגנונות או ניסיון מקצועי.
expected_points: She played the overwhelmed junior doctor Shruti in This Is Going To Hurt.
She starred as aspiring writer Emma Morley in One Day.
She plays the lawless covert agent Laila in Black Doves.
She performs extreme action stunts in the spy thriller.
She brings dark or dry humour to characters.
She joined a sketch-comedy group at Durham University and previously performed stand-up.

tasks.prompt: How do Mod's selective career choices challenge stereotypes while also limiting the number of roles she accepts?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לקשר בין דחיית תפקידים סטריאוטיפיים, בחירה בדמויות מורכבות והמגבלות המערכתיות בתעשייה.
expected_points: She treats changing portrayals of South Asian women as a guiding principle.
She refuses tokenistic or stereotypical parts.
This protects the progress made through complex roles such as Shruti, Emma and Laila.
Systemic racism and under-representation already reduce opportunities for South Asian actors.
Being selective may mean fewer credits, but it helps change the range of characters shown on screen.

tasks.prompt: Summarise Mod's career, her view of representation and what appealed to her about Black Doves in 4–5 sentences.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכלול תפקידים קודמים, טענתה על חסמים, דרך בחירת התפקידים ומאפייני ליילה.
expected_points: Mod gained recognition through This Is Going To Hurt and One Day.
She says systemic racism makes it difficult for South Asian actors to advance.
She avoids tokenistic or stereotypical roles and seeks complex characters that change on-screen narratives.
Her Black Doves character Laila subverts spy tropes and involves demanding stunts.
She also values challenging work, enjoyable collaborators and the possibility of more comedy.

tasks.prompt: Write a short set of casting principles that could improve opportunities for under-represented actors.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להציע עקרונות מעשיים הנשענים על הכתבה ולא להסתפק בסיסמאות כלליות.
expected_points: Offer under-represented actors complex lead and supporting roles rather than token parts.
Avoid relying on cultural stereotypes.
Track representation in senior, creative, production and on-screen positions.
Make advancement possible across a sustained career, not only through one breakthrough role.
Listen to performers' goals and allow them to work across drama, action and comedy.
